title: PoseBatchMessage
description: Motion client to runtime: one pose record per sample, in sequence order, about every 20 ms and before any event of a later sample (SPEC.md section 9).

world.description: The world of every pose in the batch: a batch never spans a world switch.

pose.title: Pose
pose.description: The agent after the motion core processed sample seq (ADR-0001 R1). Lengths in scene units (1 unit = 1 cm), +Y up; yaw 0 looks down -Z, positive counter-clockwise seen from above.

feet_y.description: Height of the agent's feet; the eye is at feet_y + eyeHeight (ADR-0001 R3).

yaw.description: Heading in radians, as the motion core integrated it.

contact.description: The mover met a wall during this sample.

airborne.description: No floor under the agent after this sample (falling).
